verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents an API rate limit, returning 429 with a Retry-After header, and a free-tier quota of 10 conversions per day. These are real documented limits a developer can plan around, but they cover only a sliver of the story. The rate limit is a request limit, which only approximates concurrency. Missing for 10: documented file-size limits, conversion duration/timeout limits, explicit concurrent-job limits, and the actual rate-limit thresholds.

support.subject: As a developer, file-size, duration, and concurrency limits are documented, so I can size jobs before hitting a wall

citations.quote: If the limit is reached, a 429 error is returned, and there is a Retry-After header with the time in seconds to wait before the next request.
Start free with 10 conversions per day.
